title: Analyst 4 - Billing Operations & Solutions
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.  
**Job Summary**

The Access Control Analyst supports enterprise access provisioning across billing, customer care, and operational platforms to help ensure employees and business partners have accurate, timely, and appropriate system access. The role supports access requests, provisioning workflows, approvals, exception management, operational controls, and compliance requirements while partnering across business and technology teams to deliver consistent and reliable access experience. As a lead professional-professional 4, this role operates with a high degree of independence in a complex, high-volume environment and exercises judgment in matters of significance. The role provides subject-matter expertise, leads projects and improvement initiatives, and identifies opportunities to strengthen controls, improve automation, reduce provisioning fallout, and enhance the access experience.

**Job Description**

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Supports enterprise control-access provisioning for billing, customer care, commerce, PII, and other operational platforms.
* Analyzes complex access requests, business requirements, approval standards, and system dependencies to determine the appropriate provisioning action.
* Supports joiner, mover, and leaver processes by validating that system access aligns with an employee’s job status, job code, organizational assignment, and approved access configuration.
* Reviews automated provisioning outcomes and investigates records that require manual processing or exception handling.
* Analyzes job-code, location, division, and business information to support accurate provisioning within the appropriate system environment.
* Validates access assignments against approved role-based, job-code-based, or standards.
* Review access requests for completeness and confirm that required manager, business, security, or secondary approvals are in place before provisioning.
* Investigate provisioning fallout, incomplete requests, access discrepancies, and other exceptions; determine contributing conditions and coordinates resolution with the appropriate partners.
* Identifies recurring provisioning exceptions and recommends configuration, process, documentation, training, or automation improvements.
* Applies established access-control requirements and approval standards when reviewing and fulfilling control-access requests.
* Supports access-review, audit, control-testing, and compliance activities by providing complete, accurate, and timely documentation or evidence.
* Helps ensure that sensitive and PII-related access is provisioned only after required approvals and validations have been completed.
* Identifies potential control gaps, processing risks, and inconsistent access conditions and escalates concerns through the appropriate channels.
* Maintains accurate records of access requests, approvals, provisioning decisions, exceptions, and remediation activities.
* Monitors request volumes, case activity, aging, service-level performance, and other operational measures across supported tools and work queues.
* Analyzes missed service levels, processing trends, and recurring issues to identify contributing factors and recommend corrective actions.
* Develops and maintains operational reporting that provides visibility into workload, performance, exceptions, and emerging risks.
* Uses Excel and other reporting or analytical tools to reconcile data, identify trends, validate results, and support operational and leadership decisions.
* Documents business rules, access requirements, provisioning logic, operational procedures, and exception-handling requirements.
* Translates business and control requirements into actionable workflow requirements, provisioning configurations, and process improvements.
* Evaluates the potential impact of access-policy, job-code, system, workflow, or configuration changes on related processes and supported users.
* Supports testing and business validation for access-management enhancements, system changes, and automated provisioning improvements.
* Creates clearly defined success measures for new or revised processes and establishes plans to monitor performance and results.
* Serves as a liaison among business partners, system owners, security teams, technology teams, audit partners, and access-management teams.
* Communicates access requirements, request status, exceptions, risks, and resolution plans clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Facilitates cross-functional alignment on access standards, operating procedures, escalation paths, service expectations, and process improvements.
* Leads assigned projects or workstreams with limited guidance and provided directions to other team members as needed.
* Exercises independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Maintains regular, consistent, and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights, weekends, variable schedules, and overtime as business needs require.
* Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Preferred Qualification****s**

* Experience supporting identity and access management, control-access provisioning, system administration, business operations, or a comparable operational function.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex requests, business rules, approval requirements, operational procedures, and system dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate exceptions, identify contributing factors, and recommend sustainable solutions.
* Proficiency with Excel and experience using data to perform reconciliations, identify trends, measure performance, and support decisions.
* Experience managing work against established service levels, operating procedures, approval standards, and internal controls.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accuracy while working in a high-volume operational environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex requirements to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across business, security, technology, audit, and operational teams.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and independently resolve complex operational issues.
* Experience documenting business requirements, process flows, decision logic, operating procedures, or control requirements.
* Experience supporting CSG/ACSR or comparable billing and customer-management platforms.
* Familiarity with Einstein360, XOE, Celestial, NOW, CRM, or related customer care and operational tools.
* Experience working with enterprise access-request or provisioning platforms, including MyComcastAccess or Tech Spot.
* Familiarity with automated provisioning, role-based access, job-code configurations, and joiner, mover, and leaver processes.
* Experience investigating provisioning fallout, manual exceptions, or access discrepancies.
* Experience supporting audit requests, access reviews, sensitive-data access, or PII-related controls.

* **Work with customers and carriers** to handle incoming service requests. We will count on you to inform, educate, and make recommendations to clients, carriers and underwriters.

* **Update customer information:** Ensure account data is accurately captured, entered and maintained in our agency management system.
* **Up sell & cross sell:** work with your colleagues to find and follow-through on up-sell and cross-sell opportunities.
* **Customer service:** ensure that you and your designated sales and service team provide effective and efficient customer service.

* **You’re a client service advocate.** You’re passionate about delivering an exceptional level of customer service and support.

title: Assistant Manager - Referral & Alternative Sourcing
description:
1. Role Objective

To drive business sourcing, qualified lead generation, site visits, and bookings through Customer Referrals, Loyalty Programs, Employee Referrals, Corporate Associations, Outstation and NRI initiatives, and other alternative sourcing channels. The role is responsible for developing sustainable sourcing programs, achieving assigned business targets, improving conversion efficiency, and ensuring cost-effective execution in alignment with the organization's business plan.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Business Planning & Sourcing Strategy

1. Develop and implement sourcing plans for new project launches and sustenance business through Referral, Loyalty, Employee, Corporate, Outstation, NRI, and Alternative Sourcing channels.

2. Plan and achieve a minimum of 50% of the overall business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels, with the balance 50% attributed to marketing-led sourcing, as per the approved business plan.

3. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual sourcing targets for each channel.

4. Develop long-term sourcing strategies and scalable programs to ensure consistent business contribution across projects.

5. Identify new sourcing opportunities, assess their potential, and recommend initiatives to strengthen lead generation and business conversion.

B. Referral & Loyalty Program Management

1. Develop and execute customer referral and loyalty programs to generate qualified leads, site visits, and bookings.

2. Design structured referral initiatives to encourage existing customers to recommend the organization's projects to prospective buyers.

3. Coordinate with the Brand & Marketing Head to develop referral benefits, customer engagement initiatives, and loyalty program structures.

4. Monitor referral lead quality, customer engagement, conversion rates, and program effectiveness.

5. Identify opportunities to increase repeat business, customer advocacy, and referrals across existing projects.

C. Employee & Corporate Sourcing

1. Develop and implement employee referral programs to generate qualified prospects through the organization's internal network.

2. Establish and strengthen corporate sourcing initiatives through associations with IT companies, manufacturing companies, institutions, and other relevant organizations.

3. Plan and execute corporate engagement activities, employee outreach programs, and targeted property awareness initiatives.

4. Work with internal stakeholders to communicate project offerings and approved employee or corporate benefits.

5. Track lead generation, site visits, bookings, and business contribution from employee and corporate sourcing initiatives.

D. Outstation, NRI & Alternative Sourcing

1. Develop targeted sourcing strategies to generate business from outstation customers, NRIs, and other relevant customer segments.

2. Identify suitable markets, customer groups, and engagement opportunities to expand the organization's sourcing footprint.

3. Coordinate with the Marketing and Sales Teams to execute targeted outreach programs, customer engagement initiatives, and project presentation activities.

4. Develop alternative sourcing initiatives based on market opportunities and business requirements.

5. Monitor channel-wise performance and optimize sourcing strategies based on lead quality, site visits, bookings, and acquisition costs.

E. Site Visit Generation & Conversion Management

1. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Sales Team, and Telemarketing Team to convert sourced leads into qualified site visits and bookings.

2. Maintain a minimum 10% lead-to-walk-in ratio and 15% walk-in-to-booking ratio, as per organizational benchmarks.

3. Achieve an average booking conversion of 15% against the applicable assigned sourcing base, as defined in the approved business plan.

4. Track lead movement, follow-ups, site visit scheduling, actual walk-ins, bookings, and cancellations across all sourcing channels.

5. Identify conversion gaps and implement corrective action plans in coordination with the relevant teams.

6. Take proactive measures to minimize avoidable cancellations through timely follow-ups and customer coordination.

F. Budget & Cost Management

1. Ensure that referral benefits, loyalty incentives, employee and corporate benefits, activation expenses, and other sourcing-related costs remain within approved budgets.

2. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams to plan and monitor sourcing expenditure.

3. Track cost per lead, cost per site visit, cost per booking, and return on investment for each sourcing initiative.

4. Recommend measures to improve sourcing efficiency and maximize business contribution within approved cost parameters.

5. Ensure all benefits, incentives, and commercial commitments follow the organization's approval processes.

G. Payout Management & Operational Coordination

1. Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure accurate processing and timely settlement of approved referral benefits, loyalty rewards, and other eligible sourcing-related payouts.

2. Maintain proper documentation of referrals, lead registrations, eligibility, approvals, booking references, and payout status.

3. Resolve payout-related queries and discrepancies in coordination with the concerned teams.

4. Ensure compliance with approved payout policies, documentation requirements, and internal processes.

H. CRM, MIS & Performance Monitoring

1. Ensure disciplined usage of SFDC (Salesforce) for lead registration, source attribution, lead tracking, and booking updates.

2. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all sourcing activities and maintain reliable channel-wise data.

3. Prepare regular MIS reports covering lead generation, sourcing contribution, site visits, booking conversions, cancellations, expenditure, and program performance.

4. Review performance against monthly and quarterly targets and implement corrective measures wherever required.

5. Use data-driven insights to identify high-performing sourcing initiatives and improve overall business productivity.

I. Governance, Ethics & Compliance

1. Maintain high standards of ethics, integrity, transparency, and professional conduct across all sourcing activities.

2. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, approved benefits, documentation standards, and applicable compliance requirements.

3. Prevent unauthorized commitments, incorrect source attribution, payout irregularities, and conflicts of interest.

4. Maintain effective coordination with Marketing, Sales, Telemarketing, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Sourcing Contribution: Minimum 50% of the approved business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels.

- Lead-to-Walk-in Ratio: Minimum 10%.

- Walk-in-to-Booking Ratio: Minimum 15%.

- Booking Conversion: Average 15% against the defined sourcing base.

- Referral & Loyalty Programs: Achievement of assigned lead, walk-in, and booking targets.

- Employee & Corporate Sourcing: Achievement of approved sourcing targets.

- Outstation & NRI Sourcing: Achievement of assigned business contribution targets.

- Cost Efficiency: Sourcing expenditure maintained within approved budgets.

- Cancellation Management: Reduction in avoidable booking cancellations.

- CRM Compliance: Accurate and timely SFDC usage and source attribution.

- Payout Efficiency: Timely processing of eligible benefits and rewards.

- Reporting & Governance: Timely MIS submission and adherence to organizational policies.

4. Key Working Relationships

- Brand & Marketing Head

- Sales Team

- Telemarketing Team

- Finance Team

- Vendor Management Team

- Strategy and Business Planning Team

- Existing Customers and Referral Networks

- Corporate Organizations and Employee Networks

5. Role Expectations

The Assistant Manager is expected to demonstrate strong business ownership, relationship management, analytical capability, planning, and execution discipline. The role requires proactive identification of sourcing opportunities, close coordination with internal stakeholders, and regular engagement at project sites, including weekends when required.

Success in this role will be measured by sustainable alternative sourcing growth, achievement of assigned business targets, improved lead-to-site-visit and booking conversions, and cost-effective execution within approved budgets.

* Strong incident and problem management leadership experience, including major incident command and post-incident review facilitation.

* Ability to advise application teams on observability best practices (instrumentation, tracing context propagation, structured logging) without needing to write code in a specific language.
* Strong grasp of resiliency and failure patterns (retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, caching, graceful degradation) and how to detect their failure modes through observability data.

* Datadog advanced/expert certifications, or equivalent recognized observability certifications.
* Strong scripting/automation background (Python, Terraform, or similar) for Datadog-as-code and custom tooling.
* Experience with FinOps or cost governance for observability tooling at scale.
* Exposure to multiple observability ecosystems (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
* Experience presenting to senior stakeholders or clients on observability maturity and roadmaps.

* Strategic thinking with the ability to balance immediate incident needs against long-term platform health.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capability across L1/L2 engineers.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

description:
**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.


**Job Summary:**


This job identifies issues and recommends best practices, leading functional projects that drive business improvements. They partner with teams to analyze business trends and facilitate collaboration among team members. This role assesses and reports on the progress of strategic initiatives, contributing to the organization's success.

* Partner with teams to analyze business trends and inform strategic decisions.
